# MarketplaceRules

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Publish` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public static class MarketplaceRules
```

The rules for the marketplace fields of [`ExportOptions`](Nfty.Core.Publish.ExportOptions.md), stated once.

## Remarks

Every method returns the sentence to show (or null when the value is fine) instead of throwing, so the export dialog can put the reason beside the field as the user types, the CLI can refuse with it, and [`SetExporter`](Nfty.Core.Publish.SetExporter.md) can refuse the same value with the same words. Nothing here guesses: a base URI missing its trailing slash is an error, not a slash added for the author.
